title: Implement the authenticated ingest-target context endpoint

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Ingest-target API tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/inventory/test_ingest_targets_api.py

verify.summary: Fresh T3 verification passed the exact packaged mypy gate and independently proved the authorization, exact projection, filtering, redaction, owner-boundary, Caddy and cleanup behavior with a read-only Caddyfile mount, but the required exact packaged-image pytest gate failed because the test reads deploy/Caddyfile and that file is absent from the backend image.

Fresh T3 reassessment on the rebuilt packaged image passed both exact required gates and independently proved the exact active/eligible projection, complete 401/403 matrix, revocation, redaction, accepted inventory-to-staff_access/serving_control path, path-preserving Caddy boundary and disposable PostgreSQL cleanup. The previous missing-Caddyfile packaged-gate defect is resolved.

Independent adversarial review of the actual source, packaged proof, direct contracts and Compose topology found no material semantic break or operator question. Authentication fails closed through the staff_access owner, inventory retains role authorization, serving_control supplies the revalidated read-only projection, transport has no write or protected-data path, only HTTPS edge is published, and the Caddyfile packaging correction creates no runtime owner or second source of truth.

The autopilot scheduler closed TASK-015 after bounded Execution Attempt 2 corrected the packaged test input, fresh exact image-backed verification passed, and independent T3 red verification returned semantic-pass with no material finding or operator question.

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-012 RED: an active disposable photographer cannot obtain the exact eligible ingest-target projection through GET /api/inventory/ingest-targets; GREEN: the endpoint returns schema_version 1 and only active eligible СПА id/name/timezone entries, maps missing/revoked sessions to 401 and wrong roles to 403, and obtains principal/targets through accepted owner boundaries without direct writes or protected configuration in output/logs; decisive comparison: exact response/authorization matrix and boundary/redaction assertions match the contract; artifact: redacted isolated API, integration and log-scan output.
purpose: Expose the smallest authenticated context needed for the photographer to select one authoritative upload scope without merging it into upload admission.
success_outcome: An active photographer session can read the exact eligible ingest-target list, while unauthenticated and wrong-role requests fail without exposing storage or internal configuration.
anti_goals: Do not implement the Photo upload endpoint, uploader page, target mutation or operator settings.
Do not expose pipeline identities, storage data, credentials or a generic settings API.

forbidden_scope: Direct repository writes from HTTP handlers
stop_conditions: The exact response shape, photographer role or serving-target ownership would need to change.
The handler would need direct database/storage access or business orchestration.
Protected configuration or credentials would enter output or logs.

constraints: The route is GET /api/inventory/ingest-targets and returns exactly schema_version plus active eligible СПА id/name/timezone entries.
staff_access authenticates; inventory authorizes the photographer read and consumes serving_control projections.
The handler owns transport only and performs no repository write or business orchestration.
invariants: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked sessions return 401 and wrong roles return 403.
The response contains no storage identity, credential or mutable serving command.
The photographer still selects and submits authoritative visit_date.
verification_targets: Proof starts in an isolated application/PostgreSQL state with task-unique disposable staff sessions and serving-target fixtures created through their owner boundaries; transaction rollback or owner cleanup removes only those fixtures, discards the task-local captured log buffer, resets the request client, and makes rerun start from the same empty scoped state.
Exact API/authorization/boundary/redaction tests cover valid photographer, unauthenticated, revoked, wrong-role and inactive-target observations.
